name: The Past Is Rising
author: Kathryan Bywaters
Description: The Past Is Rising is a gripping story about how buried memories and forgotten truths refuse to stay silent. As the past begins to resurface, the characters are forced to confront choices they thought were long behind them. Blending emotion, mystery, and self-discovery, the book explores how unresolved history can shape the present—and how facing it can change the future.
